Asha: Quick shoutout — Ravi sprinted in to save the onboarding docs tonight. Huge help for the new hires tomorrow :sparkles:
Ravi: oh wow, thanks! I pulled the broken links and added the note about caching behavior. didn’t think anyone would notice so late :)
Evan: noticed! read through it earlier, super clear now. the example for `batch_size` is a lifesaver. :100:
Priya: +1 to the docs fix. also cheers for rescuing the office cactus watering rota — Marco left a note on the fridge and I didn’t get soaked at 9am 😂
Marco: guilty as charged. set a calendar reminder and actually watered it for once. cactus is thriving. :cactus:
Ingrid: big appreciation for the onboarding checklist update. I used it in the 1:1 tonight and the new hire was totally unblocked. thank you team :tada:
Asha: tiny reward — snack stash is on me tomorrow (cookies or savory?). vote with emoji. :cookie: for cookies, :pretzel: for savory
Ravi: :cookie: but low-sugar pls 🙏
Evan: :pretzel: savory all the way
Priya: :cookie: would love some oat cookies if possible
Marco: :cookie: +1 to oat
Ingrid: :pretzel: i'll bring hot sauce for the pretzels if they win lol
OpsBot: Reminder: office fridge audit tomorrow at 10:00 — label items or they might be donated. (automated)
Asha: also small note — if anyone wants a quick kudos line in the weekly update, ping me and I’ll add it. grateful for the late-night doc rescue. :heart:
Evan: thanks again Ravi — added a tiny blurb to the release notes about doc quality improvements
Ravi: appreciate it. sleep now. see y’all tomorrow :zzz:
Priya: ok team vote result: cookies win 4–2. oat cookies it is. see you at snack o'clock :cookie:
